# splits/ — generated by `ml/splits.py` (never edit by hand)

The `.npy` files hold `window_id`s into `data/processed/windows.npy` and are git-ignored; `python ml/splits.py` regenerates them bit-for-bit (fixed `random_state`).

| Protocol | Task | Folds | Train | Test | Validation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1 leaky | 10-class | 1 | random stratified 70 % of all stride-512 windows | random 15 % (overlaps train) | random 15 % |
| P2 recording-wise | 10-class | 4 (leave one load out) | all windows of the other 3 loads | non-overlapping windows of the held-out load | stratified 15 % of train |
| P3 bearing-disjoint | 4-class | 3 (leave one fault size out) | faults of the other 2 sizes + normal loads 0–2 | faults of the held-out size + normal load 3 (non-overlapping) | stratified 15 % of train |

Checks (`python ml/splits.py --check`): no window in two sets; P2/P3 test windows non-overlapping; no CWRU file in both train and test (P2, P3); no (fault type, fault size) bearing in both train and test (P3); every class present in every train and test set; P2/P3 test windows share no samples with training windows.
